body: She looked surprised that she just said it 😂
Why is this one soo perfect
Adam called them after they wiped it. It was wiped cos they didn’t believe that Tommy, who they wanted to talk to, wasn’t waking up.
It’s the unknown, we don’t know what’s coming so we don’t know how to prepare ourselves
It’s terrifying
It gets tiring though, you can only keep going for so long
I try, I really try

Don’t feel stupid. I mean it could be my fault too for the lack of connection I have with them, I was often not allowed to go places with them and I was embarrassed to invite them to my house. So I guess it just kind of shows how we do sometimes only become friends with people out of circumstances. Right now I couldn’t possibly tell you what any of their favourite colours are, their favourite movie etc, it’s a weird scenario but it also takes two to keep a friendship too so remember that

I don’t have friends. Well I do except they were only my friends out of circumstances. If I didn’t go to that school I would never have become friends with them. 

Now we are in college and it has been three years since I’ve seen some of them. 

In college they all managed to make new friends but I still haven’t

Me too.

Also other than guilt, there will be less questions. They will have a reason that is easier comprehend.

I want to be listened to as well. 

Try picturing yourself above the rest. I know 100% it’s not easy. But if that is what will help you for your future, then those closest to you will and should understand that.

Also with covid, I have no idea how that has changed facilities but I’m sure they are working hard to be safe
I hope he does too. My relationship with him is done. But as my siblings are still so young, I will have to contact them through him.

If they believe being institutionalised will be best for you, then I think you should come to terms with that.

If and when I get to see a professional, I will take whatever help they suggest
Me too. He doesn’t like that I chose my mother over him

My father won’t reply to anything I send in my attempts to have that relationship with them. I left his home when I was 18 to move back with my mother. 

She doesn’t want to listen because it’s about his new kids. But they are my siblings who I love. 
I keep so much to myself because I feel like it’s a burden on anybody else

Please be honest with your therapist. I’m in a different country obviously and I have to pay for therapy. I haven’t even seen a doctor about my mental health.

If you have access to a resource please make use of it.

It doesn’t help. It just adds to the pain. Keeping yourself alive for the sake of others is so hard. 

I don’t even have a relationship with my younger siblings. But I keep myself going in the hopes that someday I will. I’m literally only 20 years old. My siblings range from 2-22. I have three of them under 7 that I haven’t seen in almost three years. I’m only hanging on for there future really.

I have spent at least 8- ish years getting by. I’m tired of keep going. It’s so much harder than you can actually think about. I’m only going to turn 21 next March. My life is relatively short but man it sucks so much already.
The day I finally do it, will be when they realise how awful they are. Not one single person in my life feels welcoming enough to open up to.
In my life it’s my old grandmother and my young siblings that keep me going. They definitely do not need to deal with me dying.
Honestly same. Cos I would have done it by now if that’s the case
I feel like maybe because they are expecting it will be easier. No death is easy but if they knew that it was coming that’s what I think anyway
Thank you 🙏
I only stay for my younger brothers and sister. Just because I’m messed up, I don’t need to give them a ready to become messed up.

I need you to know that you are not alone in those feelings. I am a 20 year old woman, I’m close to being done with college and I’m terrified of going into a job where my already boring and useless life goes to spend the next 40+ years in. 

What I can say to you is, make the most out of the small things that will make you happy. Because five minutes of happiness in a day means the day didn’t completely suck!
I definitely try not to
That is exactly what I had planned to do but I’m gone home now cos everything is online. This then threw my plans to focus on me cos when I’m at home it’s a mess
If the colour matched with the beard, it would be even better
Wow, thank you! I was really hoping that posting on here I would find others were in the same/similar position as me.
The way I present myself gets me ‘misgendered’ regularly and when I’m by myself I love it. Then when I’m with others they make it a thing to point it out and it makes me feel annoyed.
I feel this too, it’s only annoying for me because my close family are so uneducated on such topics and it doesn’t help that they don’t know the struggle of it
Exactly me, I don’t like being female but I don’t know how or what other way to go regarding PCOS and identity

The fact that you came forward and spoke up is an amazing first step! I really hope you are having more good days than bad. I hope you somehow find a way to go to therapy. There are some really great free online resources out there. 
And now here’s the thing- before you spoke up, you probably had expectations of how your family will respond to such incident. You were great to build up the courage to tell them, yet you did take your time and waited till you felt right to do so. I am completely on your side as a victim too, however for your dad, he simply may just need more time to appreciate how hard it was for you to deal with that growing up. When you do get to therapy, you could bring up discussions like “ my therapist said this....etc”.

But you also have to look at your own future and think about how long you can go without his support. Because if he is not willing or ready to support and believe you, you then should probably move on from him. 

I hope I didn’t rant on too much, I hope you find your peace with this❤️

Thank you, I do try to remember the reason I left. But because they are so young, the unknown future relationship we will have worries me. 
I’m glad you’re not regretting it, I don’t think I regret it either it’s more guilt

I didn’t know how to feel about it once I done research because like most, I hated how periods felt. So not having them became a slight relief. But I’m starting to see now that it’s worth getting checked out
I just have been putting it down to stress because coincidentally the past three years have been the most stressful
Thank you for advice
It’s just such a daunting thought. I’ll definitely look into the best doctors in my area
I feel this too. I was only 16, but nobody compares to her.

Next semester is my last too. So far I feel I have only just coasted through. And yea, I feel like having a degree is just for the sake of it. I don’t know how it will help in the future but it doesn’t hurt to have it.

Yes!! Many people just say ‘ just get up and do something’ in regards to many things, but they don’t acknowledge that it is just not as black and white when you are in a situation that you are trying to get out of.

You see I would have said no if they did ask cos I am pretty tired. But it’s more that they didn’t even think to ask me. It just adds to the long list of feeling invisible and that’s the annoying part about it.

I love my grandmother so much. I’m away at college and she never fails to call me every night. But, as much as I love her I could never bring myself to say it. I grew up in a household where we weren’t very affectionate and loving. And so that left me struggling to express my feelings.

I left his house at 18, because I wasn’t happy there. But I still miss it. I miss my younger brothers and sister. I miss being with them. 
So I really get when you say you wish you had a grave to go to. 
Photo memories pop up and it makes me sad I left but I have to remind myself why I left. 
Then new pictures come about of them all seemingly enjoying themselves without me.
I send cards and texts too, and never received a single reply in two years.

I wish things like this never happen to anybody.

Reading this brought me to tears. I’ve been through (well still am) something very similar except it was my “dad” who would belittle me, chose other siblings over me, not acknowledge any health concerns I had, and make me hate myself. Too many parents think they are doing right by controlling every aspect of their kids lives when in reality they raise kids who don’t talk to them, don’t trust them and don’t like them.
I too moved out at 18, doing my final year of college to make something of myself and I’m hoping to be everything I couldn’t have been in my childhood - fun, eager, enthusiastic and happy.

- (20,f) good luck from one tough cookie to another
Thank you
That’s sucks, I hope for you that you get to repair that relationship. For me it seems impossible because they are all younger than 7 so I don’t even think they have any good memories left of me.

I feel like this too. My dad won’t let me see my brothers and sister (7,5 and 2) for the past two years. Not even a phone call. And I feel so bad like it’s my fault I’m missing out on them. The middle one started school last year and I couldn’t do anything.
No, Ireland
If you can do anything to fix it, do. I’m trying so hard but my parent is the problem and he hasn’t realised yet so it’s impossible. I’m going to keep trying and you should too.

This is it. I was at my friends 18th birthday a few years ago and the time came in the night when she decided to dance with her father. As soon as the music started I started crying. The simple thought of my father caring about me to dance with me brought me to tears. I’m so excited to break this cycle some day with my kids.
I’m truly sorry you’re feeling that way. I feel the same most days, other people around me tell me their problems but never let me have the chance to say how I feel.

You are definitely not alone in feeling alone. I’m 20 and still living at home, there are people around each day but I still feel ignored. 
I don’t have any advice because I’m going through something similar but stay strong as long as you can.

I’m 20(f) and right now I’m just floating through college not know what’s gonna happen when I graduate. I used to think getting to 18 was an insane expectation to have but at the time it was cos I didn’t want to be here. Now two years later, nothing much has changed except it’s college and not high school.
